descFull: Verbalized Sampling, a training-free prompting strategy to mitigate mode collapse in LLMs by requesting responses with probabilities. Achieves 2-3x diversity improvement while maintaining quality. Model-agnostic framework with CLI/API for creative writing, synthetic data generation, and dialogue simulation.
